name: RetroArch
description: Native RetroArch port for PS5 with cores for NES, SNES, GBA, Genesis, arcade, PSP, GameCube/Wii and PS2.
author: Mihawk
release_notes:
PS5_RetroArch-v1.0.0-beta.1
More systems. A richer library. Your PS5, ready to play.

Warning: Designed around ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4 or later. Use ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4 or a newer version with this release, including its automatic mounting of /data, USB, and extended storage inside the sandbox.

More systems. One shared library.
33 native cores · 18 new additions · Shared artwork and game details · DualSense stylus controls

More systems to play, a new game library in your browser, and artwork shared across RetroArch and EmulationStation.

At a glance
- What this beta brings
- 18 new cores. Now 33 in total, including Dreamcast, 32X, PC Engine, DOS, and Amiga.
- A visual game library. Browse, sort, and manage your collection from your phone or computer.
- Easy game setup. Add a game, fill in its details, and download artwork automatically.
- DualSense stylus. Use the touchpad for DS and 3DS touchscreen controls.

In this release
Games library · Add Game · Game inspector · Download Media · New systems

DualSense stylus · Storage and settings · EmulationStation · WebUI · QR access · Upgrading

Your games, beautifully organized
The new Games section turns the WebUI into a visual library for your collection.
- Search by name, filter by system, or jump to a letter.
- Sort by title, release date, rating, and more.
- Choose covers, 3D boxes, logos, or cartridge artwork for your game cards.

Find games by system, name, or letter.

Add a game. Make it yours.
The new + Add Game button guides you through a game backup, editable details, and media in one overlay. Choose an installed system and one legally obtained backup of a game you own; use Content for complete multi-file disc sets or folder-based games.

Game details. Find a match in LaunchBox or enter your own information.

Automatic artwork. Enabled by default. Choose your sources and watch the artwork arrive as your game is added.

Add your own media

Your own media. Add artwork, manuals, and videos. Automatic downloads keep your uploaded files.

One game. Everything within reach.
Open any game to manage its Media, Details, and Files.

Media. Browse, enlarge, or replace your game’s artwork, manuals, and videos.

Details. Edit the game’s name and information. Your changes are kept after future downloads.

Files. Replace or export your game backup, and import or export saves. Close the game and back up your progress first.

Savestate controls

Savestates. Import or export saved slots and preview their screenshots when available. Use the same game and a compatible core.

Download Media. Fill in the missing pieces.
Download artwork and game information from libretro, ScreenScraper, and LaunchBox.
- Download for a few games, one system, or your entire library.
- Choose artwork, manuals, videos, and game details.
- Set your preferred region and language.
- Fill missing media or replace it. Your own uploads are protected.
- Review uncertain matches and resume interrupted downloads.

ScreenScraper requires an account. Available media varies by game and source.

Choose your sources and their order. Downloads continue on your PS5 after you close the browser. EmuMovies support is coming later.

Full Download Media page and results

See what was added, kept, or still missing when a download finishes.
